meta_description:
83 likes, 1 comments - delish on October 29, 2026: "@mentos.usa you are simply irresistible. 

@amberruffin takes a hilarious trip through her food memories on Déjà Food. She reveals why she carries a fanny pack full of candy, recalls eating four chocolate chip cookies for lunch in high school, shares her favorite Hema hot dog from Amsterdam, and explains how a giant trash bag of cotton candy became one of her happiest food memories.

The comedian and host also talks about The Amber Ruffin Show, her Broadway debut in Some Like It Hot, dining with Roy Wood Jr. and Michael Ian Black, pickled cheese, Rosa Mexicano’s unforgettable ribs, and the foods that shaped her life and career.

Click the link in our bio to watch now!".
